item.name: Get information about all currently supported chains

request.name: Get information about all currently supported chains

description.content: If you want to learn more about how to use this endpoint please have a look at our [guide](/sdk/chains-tools).

query.description: Restrict the resulting chains to the given chainTypes. Available values: EVM, SVM, UTXO, MVM, TVM. Pass all values to get every supported chain. If this parameter is omitted, the API returns only EVM chains.

header.description: The apiKey allows you to authenticate on the API.

description.content: Added as a part of security scheme: apikey

header.description: The apiKey allows you to authenticate on the API.
